Input for the sharing-scope item (R9) · 2026-11-15T10:09Z · from the review of PR #33771 (#33683, review-a comment 6892781240)

PR #33771 keeps one `sys_record_share` row per (rule, recipient), not one per (record, recipient). A user whom k rules reach on N records now holds k·N rows. The 5000-row read cap in `buildReadFilter` / `buildWriteFilter` is therefore reached sooner, and past it some access is dropped silently (N ≤ 5000 < k·N). When R9 measures the sharing scope, please count this per-rule row multiplier. The remedy the reviewer names is the in-database share semi-join, which removes the cap, rather than a bigger cap.
